segments.he: אֶצְבְּעוֹתָיו מוּרְכָּבוֹת זוֹ עַל גַּב זוֹ, אוֹ קְלוּטוֹת. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: ״שֶׁבֶר יָד״ — אֵין לִי אֶלָּא שֶׁבֶר יָד.
segments.en: The mishna further teaches that a priest «whose fingers» or toes «are configured one upon the other, or» whose fingers or toes are «attached,» is likewise disqualified from performing the Temple service. But if they were attached from the hand or foot from above the palm of the hand or the bottom of the foot until the middle joint, or if they were attached below the joint, higher up on the finger or toe, and he cut to separate them, he is fit. «The Sages taught» in a baraita: The verse states: «“Broken-handed”» (Leviticus 21:19). «I have» derived «only» that «a broken hand» disqualifies a priest.
